settings.heading: We bring the world's best baby brands to Australia
settings.text: For over 25 years Coolkidz has partnered with international baby brands to build their retail presence, distribute them nationwide and grow their name with Australian families.

settings.title: Stock the brands parents ask for
settings.text: Independent baby stores, national chains and online retailers stock our brands across Australia. We keep shelves full and help your team sell with confidence.
settings.list:
Dedicated sales team and account management
In-store product training and merchandising advice
Reliable stock and fast national delivery
Marketing that sends parents to your store
Warranty and after-sales support for your customers

settings.title: Launch and grow in Australia
settings.text: We take international brands from first shipment to national presence, with distribution, retail relationships and local marketing under one roof.
settings.list:
National distribution and warehousing
An established retail network, independent to national
Go-to-market strategy and brand launches
Your own Australian brand website, run by us
Direct-to-parent sales through the Coolkidz shop

settings.heading: What we do
settings.text: Everything a baby brand needs in a new market, from the warehouse floor to the parent's front door.

settings.title: Distribution and warehousing
settings.text: A 7,000 sqm warehouse built for stock management, fast order processing and reliable delivery to retailers and parents nationwide.

settings.title: Marketing and go-to-market
settings.text: A 12-person in-house team for launches, paid social and search, email, content, partnerships and retail activations.

settings.title: Sales and training
settings.text: A national sales team that supports every stockist with product education, training and merchandising.

settings.title: Customer service
settings.text: Product help, orders, warranty and returns for every brand, by phone, email and our online help desk.

settings.heading: Your brand, in more baskets
settings.text: The Coolkidz shop sells every brand we distribute in one cart, with a saving for parents who mix brands. Partners get another direct channel that reaches parents already buying from the family, plus curated sets and a gift registry.
